## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Research impact

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Reproduction / tooling
- [ ] New research hypothesis
- [ ] Changes an existing published calculation
- [ ] Could change a published verdict

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] No API keys, credentials, private account data or paid/private source material are included.
- [ ] Timestamp semantics and no-lookahead behavior are explicit where relevant.
- [ ] Fees/costs are not silently reduced after seeing results.
- [ ] Any change to a preregistered rule is identified as a new hypothesis or protocol revision.
- [ ] Tests or deterministic checks cover material calculation changes.
- [ ] Limitations are stated rather than hidden.

## Evidence

Link the public data, source, issue or reproduction output supporting the change.
